equals.description: The exact string value `field` must equal for this selector to match.

field.description: The frontmatter key to read, e.g. "status".

CairnKindSelector.description: How a doc is classified into a kind: `by: "path"` (glob) or `by: "frontmatter"` (a flat YAML frontmatter field must equal a value).

description.description: What this kind actually means — shown alongside its id wherever it appears in a report.

CairnCoverageRuleScope.description: `"sibling"` restricts rule satisfaction to a `to`-kind doc in the SAME parent directory as the `from` doc. `{ under: "some/dir" }` restricts it to a `to`-kind doc nested anywhere below that project-relative directory — narrower than the unscoped corpus-wide default, broader than `"sibling"`. Omit for the default: satisfied by a `to`-kind doc anywhere in the scanned corpus.

pattern.description: A plain substring a satisfying link's raw href must contain, e.g. "https://github.com/OWNER/REPO/issues/". No regex/glob — a literal substring match.

CairnCoverageTarget.description: A declared kind id (a doc-kind target), `{ external: "path" }` — a link must resolve to a real file on disk, not to a scanned doc — or `{ external: "url", pattern }` — a link's raw href must contain `pattern`.

CairnCoverageTargetAny.description: The explicit, named form of a bare-array `to` — satisfied by a link matching ANY ONE of `any`'s targets (alternation/OR). Equivalent to `to: [...]`, not a replacement for it.

allOf.description: The minimum number of `atLeast.of` targets that must each independently have at least one satisfying link. A positive integer — `n: 0` would make the rule vacuously satisfied by nothing, defeating the point of requiring a minimum.

CairnCoverageTargetAtLeast.description: Satisfied when at least `n` of `of`'s targets EACH have their own satisfying link — general N-of-M cardinality, e.g. `{ atLeast: { n: 2, of: ["spikes", "external-evidence", "prior-art"] } }` requires links to at least 2 of the 3 listed kinds. "All of these" is `n: of.length`; there is no separate `all` variant.

CairnCoverageTargetOrAlternatives.description: A single coverage target (satisfied by any one matching link); an ARRAY of targets, or the equivalent `{ any: [...] }`, satisfied by a link matching ANY ONE of them (alternation/OR, e.g. `to: ["spikes", "external-evidence"]`); or `{ atLeast: { n, of } }`, satisfied when at least `n` of `of`'s targets EACH have a satisfying link (general N-of-M). Every array form is non-empty — see each element's own `CairnCoverageTarget` shape.

CairnCoverageRequirement.description: How a rule is satisfied. Only `by: "link"` (a direct outbound reference) today.

description.description: Human-readable guidance shown in the report when this rule is unmet — what the relationship means and how to satisfy it, not just its name. Mandatory whenever `name` is set.

name.description: Distinguishes this rule from another sharing the same from/to pair (e.g. "implements" vs "verified_by"). Two rules on the same pair with no name, or the same name, are treated as one.

CairnCoverageRule.description: Every doc of kind `from` must link somewhere to a doc of kind `to` — or, when `to` is `{ external: "path" }`, to a real file on disk, or, when `to` is `{ external: "url", pattern }`, to a URL containing `pattern`. `to` may also be an ARRAY of targets, satisfied by a link matching ANY ONE of them (alternation/OR).

CairnDocCoverageGroup.description: One named group of docs whose outbound links count as covering a source file.

exempt.description: Globs exempted from source-tree coverage — a source file matching one is never reported.

CairnDocCoverageConfig.description: Opt-in check that every source file matching `sources` is linked to by at least one doc matching one of the `coveredBy` groups. Absent by default — presence enables it. Direct links only (a citation chain through an intermediate doc does not count), matching `checks.coverage`'s own non-transitive rules.

exempt.description: Globs exempted from orphan detection — a doc matching one is never reported as orphaned.

anyOf.description: Opt-in structural coverage/orphan check over a declared doc-kind graph. Absent by default — presence enables it.

links.description: Enable Markdown dead-link checking. Default true.

summaries.description: Enable summary freshness checking (content-hash based). Default true.

CairnNamingConfig.description: Configurable filenames for the summary system.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URL for editor autocomplete/validation. Ignored by cairn.

ignore.description: Globs to exclude from scanning. Default ["**/node_modules/**"].

locale.description: Prose locale for generated guidance and report strings. Default "en".

onlyGitTracked.description: Restrict the scanned file universe to files `git ls-files` reports as tracked/staged (issue #48) — so a local run sees the same files a fresh CI checkout would, ignoring untracked scratch docs and links to them. Default false (unchanged, glob-only behavior).

requireDirSummaries.description: Require a directory summary in every in-scope directory. Default true.

roots.description: Documentation roots to scan (globs allowed). Default ["docs"]. A pattern with no ".." segment anywhere and no absolute path must resolve inside the project directory — it fails loudly if the resolved directory turns out to be a symlink pointing outside it. Use a ".." segment or an absolute path to intentionally point a root outside the project (e.g. a monorepo sibling).

stampCommand.description: Command agents should run to stamp hashes after editing docs.

allOf.description: Line count above which a file needs a summary. Non-negative integer. Default 30.

CairnConfig.title: cairn configuration
CairnConfig.description: Configuration for the cairn CLI (.cairnrc.json, .cairnrc, or the "cairn" key of package.json).
